note: Every line the app speaks outside a protocol step. Protocol lines live in src/protocols/corpus. tools/render_voice.py pre-renders all of both. Keep each line at or under 12 words, and spell numbers and letters the way they should be spoken.

lines.micLost: I can't hear you during the call. Tap the screen instead.
lines.groundFallback: I don't know. Keep doing compressions.
lines.emsHere: Paramedics are here. Show them this screen.
lines.practiceStart: Practice. Push on a firm cushion, in time with me.
lines.offline: No signal. I still have everything I need.
lines.scanUnsure: I can't tell from the photo. Tell me what you see.
lines.groundFallbackGeneral: I don't know that one. Ask the 911 dispatcher.
lines.sensorPlace: Lay the phone on their chest.
lines.sensorHow: Top on the chest. Bottom on the belly. Let go.
lines.sensorNone: No normal breathing seen. Start CPR.
lines.sensorMoving: The chest is moving. Is it normal breathing, or gasping?
lines.sensorUnsure: I couldn't measure. Watch the chest.
lines.paceSlower: A little slower. Push on every click.
lines.paceUnfelt: I can't feel your pushes from here. Follow the clicks.
lines.sensorDoubt: If you're not sure, treat it as not breathing.
lines.cantCall: I can't call. Call 911 on your phone.
lines.noAddress: I don't have your address. Look for a street sign or a house number.
lines.sevDegree1: Sounds like a first degree burn.
lines.sevDegree2: Sounds like a second degree burn.
lines.sevDegree3: Sounds like a third degree burn. Call 911.
lines.sevCritical: This is serious. Make sure 911 is called.
lines.sayOrTap: Say your answer, or tap it.

confirm.cpr_adult: Not breathing. We'll do this together.
confirm.cpr_child: A child, not breathing. We'll do this together.
confirm.cpr_infant: A baby, not breathing. We'll do this together.
confirm.choking: Choking. I'll walk you through it.
confirm.choking_infant: A baby choking. I'll walk you through it.
confirm.stroke: Could be a stroke. Quick check.
confirm.recovery_position: Breathing but not awake. Let's protect the airway.
